extension.summary: Keeps the Red Light loading-screen style after Red Light updates.
extension.description: Reapplies a rotating cyan-blue loading spinner with a pulsing centre, and hides Red Light's busy spinner and provider, source and filename text on its playback loading screen. Each change is applied only when the known stock layout is present, so an unrecognised Red Light layout is left untouched.
extension.news: 1.5.0: Hides the Red Light logo in the upper-left corner. Gives the spinner and source counts more room. Moves the resolve-screen title into the space the counts use. Hides Red Light's busy spinner and adds a pulsing centre to the spinner. Upgrades earlier versions in place. Covers Red Light 2.6.8, 2.7.8 and 2.8.9 loading-screen layouts.
